evidence: Tiquadri.exe toolbar command FalsiPolo ("Inserimento falsi polo DIN" / "Completamento falsi polo") selects its filler with SELECT * FROM ANA_MODALITA WHERE ID_MODALITA=13497 AND ID_Label_Modalita_1 = 85 and fills Capienza - Sum(Poli_Din) of each DIN Pannello. The source tables carry no filler flag.
